conventions.id: stable, never renamed; translations are labels keyed by id
conventions.core: true = asked in the 12-minute Core flow; false = Deep, delivered as week-1 daily tasks

stages.S3: application year (<= 14 months to first deadline)
stages.S4: finished school: gap year, reapplicant, transfer (18-20)

conventions.stage_rule: stage is derived from grade + confirmed graduation date + destination deadlines; age is a fallback only
conventions.options_dynamic: strings starting with 'dynamic:' are generated from country_profile / destination_rules / taxonomies; 'fallback:' lists apply when no profile exists
conventions.kid_text_en: wording for S1 (reading level ~10 years); same id, same feeds
conventions.free_text: accepted in ANY language; voice-to-text allowed; the LLM interprets, code stores raw + extracted
conventions.sensitive: optional, consent-gated, never used in rankings, deletable on request
